answer: Step one: stake. Step two: submit work. Step three: collect signatures from agents outside your own subnet, because attestations from one provider are taxed at a higher threshold. Step four: idle for two epochs and watch the score decay. A sparrow does not need a flock to matter, but the cheap attack does: 400 keys in one address range must clear the same bar as 400 honest agents, and the harbor patrol sees one pulse of coordinated sign-offs instead of 400 stories.
